title_sq: Apartament 1+1 ne objektin me te ri, Rruga e Barrikadave
description_sq: Apartament 1+1 te Rruga e Barrikadave per shitje. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 7 te nje objekti te ri qe perfundon ne tetor 2025 ne rrugen e Barrikadave. Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale 66.84 m2, organizohet ne nje sallon, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet dhe nje ballkon. Apartamenti ka orientim Lindje. Objekti eshte nje nder objektet me cilesore te zones ku vlen te permendet fasada e ventiluar, 3 ashensore, 3 kate parkim i nendheshem edhe shume detaje te tjera luksoze.
title_en: 1+1 apartment in the newest building, Rruga e Barricadave
description_en: 1+1 apartment on Barricade Street for sale. The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a new building that will be completed in October 2025 on Barricadave Street. The apartment has a total area of ​​66.84 m2, it is organized in a living room, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. The apartment has an East orientation. The facility is one of the highest quality facilities in the area, where it is worth mentioning the ventilated facade, 3 elevators, 3 floors of underground parking and many other luxurious details.
